_note: Labelled cases for the benchmark. Images are fetched from their published source at run time and checked against the sha256 here, so no third-party photo is redistributed with this repository. Add a case by adding an entry: truth is what the device actually is, provenance is 'real' for a photograph of a real device and 'synthetic' for a variant generated from a genuine photo.

_verdict_classes.flagged: verdict is anomalies or board_mismatch - the app is saying something is wrong
_verdict_classes.clean: verdict is no_visible_anomalies - the app is saying nothing is visibly wrong
_verdict_classes.no_claim: verdict is unusable_photo or needs_closer_look - the app declines to conclude

cases.note: A real implant recovered from a Ledger Nano X: a second PCB carrying test pads, wired to the main board. The reference case for a true positive.
Published reference photo of a genuine Model T board, top side. Trezor publishes schematic, BOM and board photos.
